simple.meaning: לוּט (lûwṭ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to wrap up.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

occurrences.englishText: David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
